ends.note: Court stops at a lumber yard (L.P. piles) at x ~3170; the yard and the Carr Street building line close it off, so Court does not reach Carr

notes: Harriet Street is offset at Gest: south of Gest it is at x 2266 (50 ft, block lines 2182/2351); the HARRIET printed north of Gest (sheet 59 side, about 32 ft wide, lines 2768/2875) is at x 2821, so two T-junctions. Carr has no opening north of Gest on this sheet. Dalton Avenue enters Gest from the north only. Richmond zig-zags: 50' printed west of Harriet, 60' east of it (60 recorded). West 9th is printed 50' west of Harriet and 60' east of it (60 recorded). The West Court width label is mostly covered by a pasted patch (only a '5' shows). Tucker Alley runs from the west sheet edge to a T at Harriet (no width printed here). Donnersberger Street (printed DONNERSBERGER, about 42 ft between block lines 2873/3015) enters West 8th from the south. Carr continues south of 8th (water main and SW block line continue; Carr shows south of 8th on the key map).
